exposure: PLP1 mutations (specifically novel mutations in exon 3B)
cohort: The study included four HEMS patients from three families who harbored novel PLP1 mutations.
finding: The study identified three novel PLP1 mutations in exon 3B across four HEMS patients, contributing to an expanded understanding of the phenotypic and genotypic spectrum of PLP1-related hypomyelination of early myelinated structures.
